TITLE: Cyber Torus Knot
DESCRIPTION: Evaluates a seamless 3-branch modular (3,5) torus knot SDF with FFT-modulated helical fluted ribs, analytical tetrahedral normals, and a 1-bounce raymarched reflection on an obsidian mirror floor. Visually special for its liquid-chrome thin-film iridescent Fresnel sheen, studio softbox reflections, and subsurface neon halo. Controls: speed (knot rotation & flow), intensity (HDR exposure), rib_twist (helical rib relief depth), invert (negative mode), hue_shift (thin-film spectrum shift), orbit XY (camera azimuth & elevation).
